files.name: motion-prompt-075.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Sticky header" (追従ヘッダー), one of the names in "Landing page & web effects".
Motion Prompt #075

What it is: The header stays at the top while the page scrolls
What the sample shows: The announcement strip scrolls away, but the header below it stops at the top edge and the content scrolls underneath.
Spec:
- Scroll: 0→110 px at 0.4–1.3 s, 110→250 px at 1.9–2.8 s, 250→0 at 3.4–4.4 s (cubic ease-in-out).
- At the very top, a 22 px announcement strip (navy); below it a 34 px header (logo, three menu items, button).
- Header position = max(22 − scroll, 0): once the strip is gone, it stops at the top edge (position: sticky; top: 0).
- Over the next 24 px of scroll, a 12 px shadow under the header fades from 0 to 0.16 opacity.
- The content (photo, heading, three cards) scrolls normally under the header.
When to use it: Use it to keep the menu and the call-to-action within reach on a long page.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/075.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/lp.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
